scope: Follow-up to research-intake-audit-2026-10-06.json: resolve the PIXAR and spiking paper identities, add a structured Work row for the Mamba paper already cited in the state-space article, and verify the MLSys metadata for existing Work KWRK-000048. No claim or evidence acceptance is performed.
method: Checked pinned arXiv abstract/version pages, the official MLSys 2026 proceedings page, the existing article citation, and public Long-Haul issues #153 and #165. No private project source pointers or results are included.

resolved_source_leads.identity: PIXAR: Auto-Regressive Language Modeling in Pixel Space
resolved_source_leads.disposition: Exact title, authors, and version resolved. The paper is about autoregressive pixel-space text generation; it is not treated as a general page-vision source or evidence of a relationship with spiking systems.

resolved_source_leads.identity: SpikingBrain2.0: Brain-Inspired Foundation Models for Efficient Long-Context and Cross-Platform Inference
resolved_source_leads.disposition: Exact primary paper identity recorded. Public Long-Haul issue #153 mentions an SNN comparison but contains no direct bibliographic citation; correspondence between that project note and this paper is not asserted as a verified crosswalk.

registry_gap_filled.identity: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
registry_gap_filled.disposition: Existing prose citation was not yet represented in ExternalWork; this adds the source identity only.

crosswalks.candidate_target: The uncited recent-MLSys speculative-decoding sentence in public Long-Haul issue #165
crosswalks.rationale: The official proceedings confirms that KWRK-000048 is the 2026 MLSys paper and its subject and production-grade vLLM evaluation match the issue sentence. Issue #165 does not name or link the paper, so the relationship remains inferred. The paper’s reported workloads are not Kestrel measurements.

project_boundary_updates.disposition: Public Long-Haul issue #48 uses the term for hierarchical outer model routing over inner MoEs. This is distinct from Tilde’s MoMoE software Work KWRK-000076.
KWRK-000073 is the pinned software source; its proposed use is not a measured or established scientific relationship.

source_findings_boundary: PIXAR and SpikingBrain2.0 notes summarize only their authors’ reported scopes. No result is transferred to Kestrel, browser inference, consumer applications, or a combined PIXAR/spiking design. No ExternalClaim or KnowledgeEvidence row is added.
